Name: A Second Vat
Description: A second lagering vat for the Cooling cellar.
Notes: ROUND AN (Anthony: an achievement only grants the RIGHT to buy an upgrade; you buy it at the Club House). ONE ROW PER UPGRADE. Achievement = the ID of a row of data/Achievements.csv - once that achievement is earned the upgrade is for sale. Blank = for sale from the start. Needs = any extra condition in the usual language (unlocked:x, count:x>=n). Cost and Currency use data/Currencies.csv. Effect is the ordinary effects language: count:batches_<section>+1 is a Brewery vat, count:tune_<any Tuning row>+n raises a number, unlock:x opens a thing. Each upgrade is bought once. WAS a free Reward on the A Second Vat achievement KIND (round AN): upgrade or key - the Club House lists the keys first, under KEYS.

Name: Dorms Key
Notes: THE KEYS (round AN, Anthony: to get into a building or to work a machine you BUY its key). Achievement is blank on a key: the RIGHT to buy it is Needs = unlocked:<name>, which is still handed out by the achievement that always opened that building (Achievements.csv Unlocks), so moving the unlock moves the key too. Effect gives the key, an item of data/Items.csv (Kind key, Tab keys) - it shows in the bag's Keys tab. The building's Requires (Buildings.csv) or the machine's Needs (BrewerySections.csv) asks count:<key>>=1. The Club House itself has no key: it is where keys are bought.
